about: Saint-Raymond is a city in Portneuf, Quebec, northwest of Québec City in the Laurentian foothills. A gateway to Jacques-Cartier National Park and the Vallée Bras-du-Nord, it mixes a small urban core with forest recreation and Portneuf countryside. About 10,000 people live in Saint-Raymond.
seoSummary: Portneuf Laurentian-foothills city northwest of Québec City—gateway to Jacques-Cartier Park and Vallée Bras-du-Nord.
